info.title: KKRM Public Relations API
info.description: Laravel 13 API. Internal accounts are public relations staff. Expert portal is external https://my.kkrm.ir/. Cookie authentication with CSRF; no registration or bearer tokens. Generated from application validation contracts. Demo rates and legal content have no official validity.
